procedure: Compare invite list with approved eligible-user roster

procedure: Compare requested roles with manager-approved job responsibilities
expected_result: Each user has a least-privilege role approved by the business owner

procedure: Reconcile required modules and training completion by user
expected_result: Mandatory training is complete or a documented exception exists

procedure: Test sign-in and permitted/forbidden actions for representative roles
expected_result: Approved access succeeds and unauthorized actions fail

procedure: Track pilot support issues and unresolved access blockers

procedure: Compare active users and eligible users over the same period
